title: Mechanics
description: Apply calculus to motion problems: use all forms of acceleration ($\frac{dv}{dt}$, $v\frac{dv}{dx}$, $\frac{d}{dx}(\frac{1}{2}v^2)$); analyse simple harmonic motion including derivation of displacement and velocity; solve motion problems with resistance proportional to velocity or $v^2$, including terminal velocity and projectile motion with air resistance.
